countryCode.description: The country code in two-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

Business.description: Information about the seller's business. Certain fields may be omitted depending on the seller's `businessType`.

companyRegistrationNumber.description: The seller's company registration number, if applicable. This field will be absent for individual sellers and sole proprietorships.

companyTaxIdentificationNumber.description: The seller's company tax identification number, if applicable. This field will be present for certain business types only, such as sole proprietorships.

nonLatinName.description: The non-Latin script version of the registered business name, if applicable.

code.description: An error code that identifies the type of error that occurred.

message.description: A message that describes the error condition in a human-readable form.

details.description: Additional details that can help you understand or fix the issue.

Error.description: Error response returned when the request is unsuccessful.

ErrorList.description: A list of error responses returned when a request is unsuccessful.

countryCode.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format country code of the marketplace.

defaultCurrencyCode.description: The ISO 4217 format currency code of the marketplace.

defaultLanguageCode.description: The ISO 639-1 format language code of the marketplace.

domainName.description: The domain name of the marketplace.

Marketplace.description: Information about an Amazon marketplace where a seller can list items and customers can view and purchase items.

storeName.description: The name of the seller's store as displayed in the marketplace.

isParticipating.description: If `true`, the seller participates in the marketplace. Otherwise `false`.

hasSuspendedListings.description: Specifies if the seller has suspended listings. `true` if the seller Listing Status is set to Inactive, otherwise `false`.

Participation.description: Information that is specific to a seller in a marketplace.

PrimaryContact.description: Information about the seller's primary contact.

name.description: The full name of the seller's primary contact.

nonLatinName.description: The non-Latin script version of the primary contact's name, if applicable.
